label: Measure
help: Click two items in the viewport or the project tree: fitted shapes, reference geometry or body faces; origin planes and axes are in the list. For fitted shapes the value is followed by its measurement uncertainty from the scan. The values are only shown, not stored in the project.
pickHint: Choose in the viewport or the project tree.
chooseSecond: Choose a second item to measure distance and angle.
notParallel: Not parallel ({{angle}}): no distance is defined.
